description.text: The course of Nursing has Autumn intake only. Objectives: Trainings of highly qualified medical professionals who bears the fundamental theories on basic and clinical medicine.These medical professionals should undertake medical diagnosis, treatments and prevention on common and frequently occurring diseases of oral cavity in health and medical institutions. Degree Awarded: Bachelor of Medicine Employment Orientation: Graduates are supposed to undertake teaching and oral diseases treatments in medical schools, hospitals and clinics at all levels.

duration.text: The Nursing at Tianjin Medical University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4305 USD/per year ￥ 31000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency.

requirements.text: The applicant must be a high performing school graduate. The age must be over 18 and under 30 years old.
